body.label: Opposing counsel
body.value: Jennifer L. McGhan, McGhan Law LLC — jenn@mcghanlaw.com

body.text: "Your Honor, William Johnson, pro se, 2025CV936. I ask the Court to consider the documentary record on discovery, the pending protective-order motion, and the written-order issues I briefed. I am prepared to answer questions."
The record shows good-faith compliance and pending motions; contempt should not flow from objections and productions already on file — adjust to facts you confirm in the clerk's file.
If needed: ask the Court for sensory or pacing accommodation. Brenda O'Dell is your designated support person (see contacts above).
On the record, use initials only if the Court requires it; never full names in public posts or non-filing contexts.
